citation.author: Ho, H.-C.

citation.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
citation.attribution: Ho, H.-C. (2022). Taxonomy and Distribution of the Deep-Sea Batfish Genus Halieutopsis (Teleostei: Ogcocephalidae), with Descriptions of Five New Species. Journal of Marine Science and Engineering, 10(1), 34. https://doi.org/10.3390/jmse10010034

question: Does an independent publication verify the geographic position of Albatross station D.5115, and does that explicitly identify station D.5115 as the station for USNM 122919?

independentStationComparator.coordinateScope: Published for Albatross station D.5115 in the USNM 182931 catalog lot only. Do not transfer this coordinate to USNM 122919.
independentStationComparator.reportedLocality: Balayan Bay and Verde Island Passage, Sombrero Island
independentStationComparator.evidenceRole: Independent geographic and station-depth comparator. This is a different catalog identity from USNM 122919 and is not a second Ventrifossa divergens record.

crossChecks.sourceLocality: Sombrero Island; Balayan Bay and Verde Island Passage

crossChecks.sharedHeading: Balayan Bay and Verde Id. Passage — Continued

interpretation.stationPosition: The 2022 paper independently reports the position and 622 m depth of station D.5115 for a distinct USNM 182931 lot collected on the same date. This corroborates the station table's geography.
interpretation.usnm122919Crosswalk: D.5115 remains a strong date/depth inference for USNM 122919 because the 2015 depth of 623 m is consistent with the 622 m station row and not the 366 m D.5116 row. The new paper does not mention USNM 122919, so the station assignment is still not explicit.
interpretation.waterbodyScope: The cited records use the combined Balayan Bay / Verde Island Passage locality. Do not narrow this to Balayan Bay alone.
interpretation.identityBoundary: Do not treat USNM 182931 as a new occurrence of Ventrifossa divergens, or merge its station coordinate into the USNM 122919 catalog record.

decision.nextEvidenceNeeded: Direct NMNH/Smithsonian field-ledger or catalog clarification that links USNM 122919 to D.5115 or D.5116 and resolves the combined locality scope.
